description: The debug tour as shipped, with its planted bug (anti-windup off, Ctrl/aw = 0). The 1 m reference step at 0.5 s saturates the drive at 15 N, the integrator winds up, the cart crosses 1.1 m (the 'Break when' moment of the walkthrough) and then 1.2 m, where the limit switch event latches and cuts the drive. The walkthrough fixes the bug live (aw = 1); those runs are proven by web/tests/e2e/debug-tour.spec.ts, not here.

checks.note: the cart passes 1.1 m: the walkthrough's 'Break when Pos/y > 1.1' pause
the cart reaches the 1.2 m limit switch: the @events instant where 'Break on Events' pauses
the switch latched and stays latched
the overshoot peak, 24 % past the 1 m target, after the trip
the force command never exceeds the drive limit umax
the latch stays a differential state, the bond island has the Translation domain, no event-limit warning and no compiler or solver failure
